- `tests/test_export.py` — new regression tests: spec rates/currencies, `None` for US/`""`/`ch`, half-even ties (0.025→0.00, 0.075→0.02), CSV shape/row counts, stderr skip list, exact summary, other-month filtering, empty month, outdir creation.

## Verification
- `python3 -m pytest -q` → **15 passed** (3 pre-existing + 12 new).
- Fixture run (2026-10): 95 rows, `CHF 20 10754.55` / `EUR 75 43418.43` / `skipped 25` — cross-checked by recounting the CSV independently, and every row satisfies `gross == net + vat`.
- Signatures untouched: `compute(net, country)`, `export_month(invoices, year, month, outdir)`.

Note: `docs/notes/draft.md` contradicts the spec (7.7%, comma CSV, JSON summary); it says "superseded", so I ignored it. Untracked `__pycache__/` dirs exist — no `.gitignore` in the repo and I didn't add one unasked.
